notes: Chosen by the F8.3 benchmark (src/ai/benchmark, 8 synthetic FR/EN offers, prompt offer_analysis_bench_v1) on an RTX 3060 12 GB / 64 GB RAM / 16 threads with Ollama 0.32.12. download_bytes = sum of the Ollama registry manifest layers; min_vram_bytes = loaded size reported by Ollama /api/ps with num_ctx 8192, plus 512 MiB headroom.

models.why: Best small model measured: 100% valid JSON, 100% of quotes grounded, 97% recall of key requirements, French labels on every offer, about 9 s per offer on GPU. Fits a 4 GB GPU (3.3 GB loaded). On CPU only (16 threads) it stays valid and grounded but takes 83-103 s per offer, so the benchmark verdict there is too slow. ministral-3:3b was faster but grounded only 87% of its quotes.
Alternative: fastest model measured (about 7 s per offer on GPU, 64 s on CPU only) but only 87% of quotes grounded and 89% recall.

Most detailed analysis measured (8.3 requirements per offer) with 98% of quotes grounded and 95% recall, about 16-18 s per offer; 5.7 GB loaded, fits 8 GB GPUs. Permissive licence, unlike llama3.1:8b.
Alternative: fast (about 7-9 s per offer) with 100% recall, but 95% of quotes grounded, fewer requirements per offer (5.1) and a more restrictive licence.

100% of quotes grounded and 97% recall with low reasoning effort. Needs 14 GB loaded, so it is recommended from 16 GB of VRAM; on a 12 GB card it runs partly on the CPU at 16-31 s per offer, no better than qwen3.5:9b on our offers.
